basic_profile.bio: I'm a radio enthusiast based in Canada, diving into the world of numbers stations and mysterious broadcasts. By day, I work as a software developer focusing on web applications, and by night, you can find me tuning into odd frequencies. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings exploring the depths of the internet, from obscure musical finds to tech discussions. I'm most active on Reddit during late evenings (EST), when the world is quiet and the airwaves are clear.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have spent years exploring the fascinating intersection of technology and radio communications. My expertise is largely self-taught, fueled by an unending curiosity about how things work, particularly in the realm of mysterious radio signals and cryptography.
